first_win.era: Drop each MVP into the decade of their first MVP season.
first_win.shot: In what year was {label} first named the NBA's Most Valuable Player?

rows.label: Michael Jordan
rows.hook: won six championships with the Bulls and became one of the most recognized athletes on the planet

rows.label: LeBron James
rows.hook: climbed to the top of the league's all-time scoring list over an unusually long career

rows.label: Shaquille O'Neal
rows.hook: used massive size and power to become one of the most dominant centers ever to play

rows.label: Kobe Bryant
rows.hook: won five championships with the Lakers and once scored eighty-one points in a single game

rows.label: Stephen Curry
rows.hook: reshaped how the game is played by making long-range three-pointers a routine weapon

rows.label: Magic Johnson
rows.hook: ran a fast, flashy Lakers offense and later built a successful business empire

rows.label: Kevin Durant
rows.hook: combined smooth outside shooting with unusual height to become nearly impossible to guard

rows.label: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
rows.hook: used an unblockable skyhook shot to dominate the league for two decades

rows.label: Allen Iverson
rows.hook: thrilled crowds with a lightning crossover despite being undersized for his position

rows.label: Larry Bird
rows.hook: led a fierce rivalry with the Lakers for years as a sharp-shooting forward

rows.label: Wilt Chamberlain
rows.hook: scored one hundred points in a single game, a record that still stands

rows.label: Giannis Antetokounmpo
rows.hook: became famous for freakishly athletic dunks, shot-blocking, and rare speed for his size

rows.label: Bob Pettit
rows.hook: starred for the Hawks as one of the earliest great power forwards in league history

rows.label: Charles Barkley
rows.hook: out-rebounded much taller opponents throughout a Hall of Fame career

rows.label: Karl Malone
rows.hook: formed one of basketball's most productive pick-and-roll duos and piled up huge scoring totals

rows.label: Russell Westbrook
rows.hook: racked up more triple-doubles in a season than any player in modern history

rows.label: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
rows.hook: became known for a smooth, deceptive scoring style built on footwork and pace changes

rows.label: Derrick Rose
rows.hook: became the youngest player ever to win the league's top individual honor

rows.label: Nikola Jokić
rows.hook: passes like a point guard despite playing center, redefining the position

rows.label: Dirk Nowitzki
rows.hook: brought an unstoppable one-legged fadeaway jump shot that defenders couldn't solve

rows.label: Hakeem Olajuwon
rows.hook: used a dazzling footwork combo known as the Dream Shake to torment defenders

rows.label: Tim Duncan
rows.hook: quietly anchored a championship dynasty with fundamentally sound, unflashy play

rows.label: James Harden
rows.hook: drew fouls with a signature stepback three and led the league in scoring for years

rows.label: Steve Nash
rows.hook: ran a high-scoring, up-tempo offense as one of the game's best passing point guards

rows.label: Bill Russell
rows.hook: anchored a dynasty that won eleven championships in thirteen seasons

rows.label: Kevin Garnett
rows.hook: brought relentless intensity and versatile defense to every team he played for

rows.label: Julius Erving
rows.hook: popularized above-the-rim dunking and helped make the slam dunk contest famous

rows.label: Moses Malone
rows.hook: dominated the offensive glass better than almost anyone who ever played center

rows.label: David Robinson
rows.hook: combined shot-blocking and scoring as one of the most complete centers of his era

rows.label: Bob Cousy
rows.hook: pioneered flashy ball-handling and set the mold for the modern point guard

rows.label: Oscar Robertson
rows.hook: averaged a triple-double for an entire season, a feat considered impossible for decades
